charts.title: TOI-628 b: orbits around TOI-628
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-628's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-628 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Rodriguez et al. 2021 (2021AJ....161..194R), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname RODRIGUEZ_ET_AL__2021): P 3.4095675 d

charts.title: TOI-628 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-628 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 1 sector (87) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 281408474, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 14 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 18 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 15-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 14 min early; 15-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 6 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
